reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it urges viewers to join the OneCoin structure and pursue profit through its network and upline. It promotes claims of over €35,000 in weekly commissions, coin creation as a way of creating money, and projected coin values, while presenting future possibilities rather than verified outcomes. The merger and Monday-payment statements further contribute to the promotional context, although the records do not independently establish the speakers’ affiliations, the merger, coin values, actual payments, or any viewer’s participation or loss.

citations.quote: you have taken right decision to join this Empire starting now
thousands of thousands of thousands of people in the OneCoin world are making over 35 thousand euros in commissions every week
We focused on a commission plan that is simple and duplicateable.
for each week we would make network commissions Every single week
take this opportunity, listen to your network and your upline, learn from the best, and profit from the maximum

opening.argument: Judge, read the coin-value figures as forecasts, not promises of a fixed return. The speaker says “if you get in today” and “approximately” for one figure, then “probably” for a later one. He also makes the outcome depend on whether a person chooses to create coins. Those qualifications matter: this is a speculative discussion of a proposed coin’s future value, not evidence that the speaker guarantees any viewer a payout.

citations.quote: if you get in today, approximately the value will have its value at 5 euros
When we come in public, probably the value of your coin will be at 20 euros
Now it depends on if you want to create coins or not

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution points to a large weekly-commission claim, but that is phrased as a claim about people already earning commissions, not a promise that every viewer will earn that sum. Its quoted invitation to join does not erase the conditional wording around the projected coin values. The cited statements support skepticism about the claims; they do not, by themselves, establish a guaranteed-return offer.

citations.quote: thousands of thousands of thousands of people in the OneCoin world are making over 35 thousand euros in commissions every week
probably the value of your coin will be at 20 euros

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Conditional coin forecasts do not resolve the central concern. The speaker urges the audience to join, describes a “simple and duplicateable” commission plan, and says participants would make network commissions every week. The case does not require an unconditional coin-price guarantee: the promoted opportunity itself centers on recurring network earnings.

citations.quote: you have taken right decision to join this Empire starting now
We focused on a commission plan that is simple and duplicateable.
for each week we would make network commissions Every single week

opening.argument: Judge, much of this address explains a planned operational transition to an existing audience. The opening speaker discusses moving networks into a login and a recovery plan; the next speaker describes coin creation and calls the network arrangement a four-step system. Even the closing asks listeners to learn from their network. That makes the video reasonably readable as an update and explanation of how the proposed arrangement would work, rather than a transaction in which viewers are asked to hand over money or credentials.

citations.quote: You in the maximum Monday will have your networks all inside the One Point will have you in the login and password, and within our recovery plan
One is from the building of the coin creating the coin, mining the coin
It's a 4 step system
listen to your network and your upline, learn from the best

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution’s quotes identify commissions and an upline, but neither quote alone explains what a viewer must do to obtain them. It gives too little weight to the stated network migration and recovery plan, which provide a reason for addressing current members about operations. “Learn from the best” can be instruction to that audience, not necessarily a request to recruit someone else.

citations.quote: within our recovery plan
listen to your network and your upline, learn from the best

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The operational details are embedded in an overt pitch. The speaker calls joining the right decision, claims substantial weekly commissions, and tells listeners to take the opportunity and profit. Calling the arrangement a system or asking people to learn it does not turn those earning claims into a neutral tutorial.

citations.quote: you have taken right decision to join this Empire starting now
thousands of thousands of thousands of people in the OneCoin world are making over 35 thousand euros in commissions every week
take this opportunity, listen to your network and your upline, learn from the best, and profit from the maximum

opening.argument: Judge, the speaker describes two distinct sources of potential value: creating a coin and earning network commissions. Crucially, he says a participant does not necessarily have to build a team. That undercuts an inference that every participant’s earnings require personally recruiting others. The supplied speech describes a commission plan, but does not specify a required deposit, a purchase price, or a mandatory number of recruits. On this record, the narrower reading is promotion of a proposed business arrangement, not a demonstrated recruitment-dependent mechanism.

citations.quote: It's a opportunity, you don't necessarily have to build a team
You make money from both sides of the coin
One is from the building of the coin creating the coin, mining the coin
for each week we would make network commissions Every single week

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution treats “network commissions” and “upline” as decisive, yet neither quoted phrase establishes that a viewer must recruit a downline or pay to participate. The speaker expressly says building a team is not necessary. The reference to an upline shows how listeners are told to seek guidance; it does not, without further detail, establish the source of every commission.

citations.quote: you don't necessarily have to build a team
listen to your network and your upline, learn from the best

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The evidence need not show that every participant personally recruits others. The video promotes an opportunity through a repeatable commission plan, weekly network commissions, and advice to follow an upline, alongside striking earnings claims. The absence of a stated deposit or mandatory recruit count does not make that recurring network-earnings pitch ordinary commerce.
